summary: The PR addresses the issue of ignoring settings in certain subexpressions by ensuring that the printer settings are applied consistently. However, there are some concerns regarding test coverage and potential impacts on other parts of the code.

issues.description: While the provided examples demonstrate the fix, additional tests should be added to ensure that the settings are respected across all relevant subexpressions and scenarios.
The change may introduce behavioral regressions if other parts of the code rely on the previous behavior of not applying printer settings to certain subexpressions. This needs to be verified.
